title: Lalu Prasad Yadav Seeks AIIMS Treatment in Delhi
text:
breaking news: Former Bihar Chief Minister Lalu Prasad Yadav has been flown to Delhi for urgent medical care. This article provides a detailed update on the circumstances surrounding Lalu Prasad Yadav’s recent health issues, his transfer to AIIMS, and the concerns shared by his family. Stay informed about the latest developments in the healthcare situation of this prominent political figure.
Lalu Prasad Yadav Flown to Delhi for Medical Treatment Former Bihar Chief Minister Admitted to AIIMS Following health concerns
Published: February 29, 2024
Urgent Transfer to Delhi Lalu Prasad Yadav, president of the Rashtriya Janata dal (RJD) and former chief minister of Bihar, was transported to Delhi Wednesday for specialized treatment at the All India Institute of Medical sciences (AIIMS). This transfer followed a brief hospitalization in Patna, prompted by emerging health complications.
Tejashwi yadav,his son and current Leader of the Opposition,addressed reporters,detailing the circumstances leading to his father’s transfer. The decision was made to seek expert medical intervention for sores that had developed on Mr. Yadav’s back and arm. Mr. Yadav hopes to get operated upon in Delhi.
Timeline of Events Afternoon: Mr. Yadav arrived at the airport, accompanied by his mother, Rabri Devi, ready to board a flight to Delhi. Sudden Health Issue: A precipitous drop in blood pressure was detected, necessitating immediate medical attention. Emergency Care: The family promptly transported Mr. Yadav to Paras Hospital in Patna. Mr. Yadav’s swift response underscores the family’s commitment to ensuring he receives the best possible care.
Doctor’s Assessment and Yadav’s Resolve Dr. Prakash Sinha, who headed the medical team overseeing Mr.Yadav’s initial treatment, provided insights into his condition upon arrival at Paras Hospital.
He was kept in the emergency ward where his condition improved after intravenous therapy. He wanted to know if he could go to Delhi in an air ambulance.We asked him to go ahead.
Dr. Prakash Sinha, Paras Hospital
Despite medical recommendations, Mr. Yadav opted for a standard commercial flight, demonstrating his resilience.
My father is a man of courage.He chose to travel by a normal flight.
Tejashwi Yadav, Leader of the Opposition
Family Concerns and Medical History Tejashwi Yadav acknowledged the family’s deep concern for his father’s well-being, given his extensive medical history. Mr. Yadav, 76, has been managing diabetes for many years and has previously undergone heart surgery and a kidney transplant. These pre-existing conditions add complexity to his current health challenges, requiring careful and specialized medical attention.
Public Appearances and political Background Once a prominent and charismatic figure in Indian politics, known for his ability to connect with the public, Mr. Yadav has, in recent years, reduced his participation in public events. However, he was recently seen at a presentation organized by the All India Muslim Personal Law Board, protesting the Waqf Bill, indicating his continued engagement with socio-political issues.
Legal History and Health During Incarceration Mr. Yadav’s political career has been marked by legal challenges. Convicted in multiple fodder scam cases, he spent a important portion of his prison sentences in hospitals, receiving medical care before his release on bail several years ago. This history underscores the ongoing health concerns that necessitate regular medical attention and specialized care.
